title: AI Text-To-Speech is about to be revolutionized by Gemini 2.0
author: RogueStargun

comments.author: RogueStargun
comments.body:
The only people able to use this right now are folks on a private passlist at Google, but this will change the game for text-to-speech.

I am already working on a Unity plugin, and I'll post it up as soon as this goes live (likely in late January)

comments.author: Reactorcore
comments.body: Bard/Gemini used to be awful, but this new stuff is amazingly good.

replies.author: outerspaceisalie
replies.body: I try to use Gemini regularly. It's still a lot worse than chatGPT. Every time I use it, I end up disappointed. It misunderstands my prompts a lot or only responds to part of them, constantly excuses itself as "under development", fails to answer questions... it often takes me 2 to 3 times as many prompts to get answers of slightly worse quality than i get out of a single prompt from chatGPT.

comments.author: somethingclassy
comments.body: Is this model going to be available locally?

replies.author: RogueStargun
replies.body:
From Google. Hah, good luck.

Meta's Llama 3.3 is multimodal however, and future versions might have native-audio like capabilities.

I'm writing a Unity plugin for Gemini 2.0's Native audio feature right now. Will post it up as soon as Native Audio goes live, and I test it out.
